[Intro]
[Dmaj7]

[Verse 1]
[Dmaj7]While I'm on Sunset, are you
on the subway?
While I drive, are you gettin'
on the Ltrain? I mean, Manhattan's
[Gmaj7]nice, but so are
Malibu nights
You would know if you stayed
You would know if you put up a fight
[Dmaj7]Your toes turn blue in winter,
I'm gettin' red, rum
Does the trick for all of the
things left unsaid, I'm
[Gmaj7]Missin' our drunken 2 A.
M. strolls in KTown
Now you're chasing fake highs in the Upper West
Side

[Pre-Chorus]
[A]And fuckin' on Brooklyns in Brooklyn
Your Chelseas in Chelsea
[Gmaj7]Hope that eases the pain,
so you remember to miss me
[A]And you sold your car,
now you walk for miles
[Gmaj7]Bet your feet feel numb
Crosswalks in my mind are shaky, so please hold on

[Chorus]
[Dmaj7]tight
All my demons run wild
[Bm7]
All my demons have your
[Gmaj7]smile In the
city of angels,
in the
city of angels
[Dmaj7]
Hope New York holds you
[Bm7]
Hope it holds you like I
[Gmaj7]do While my
demons stay faithful
In the
city of an-

[Bridge]
[Dmaj7]gels

[Verse 2]
[Dmaj7]Summer's endin' now and the
nights are coolin' down
Remember last winter when
we would drive around?
[Gmaj7]Silverlake, Hollywood,
pretty little white lies got me good
Thought this was love, I was misunder-
stood, mmm

[Pre-Chorus]
[A]Feelin' low on the low,
drivin' through NoHo
[Gmaj7]If I'm honest, I'd call,
but I'm trying to let go
[A]And I hope you're happy,
livin' life in taxis
[Gmaj7]But you'll always have me,
you'll always have me

[Chorus]
[Dmaj7]
All my demons run wild

in the

[Bm7]
Hope it holds you like I
